Chapter 10. Living the Year of Yes Beyond the Year
So, here we are. The year’s winding down, and you might feel that warm sense of accomplishment mixed with a bit of uncertainty. It’s natural to wonder, what now? Can you really keep this momentum going? Can you keep saying yes even after the excitement fades?
The answer is simpler—and deeper—than you might think. Living a year of “yes” isn’t just about ticking off boxes or chasing a list of brand-new experiences. It’s really about changing the way you see the world. It’s choosing to be open, to take those leaps, and to welcome whatever comes your way. It’s about living with intention, instead of just going through the motions.
Picture this: it’s a quiet morning, well after your official “year” is over. Maybe someone invites you to try something you’ve never done before. You still feel those familiar nerves bubbling up, but somehow, they don’t control you like they used to. Saying yes doesn’t just feel possible—it feels right. Maybe it even feels exciting.
The journey doesn’t end just because the calendar flips. The habits you’ve built, that “yes” mindset, the courage you’ve found to be seen and to give things a shot—those stick with you. Sure, you’ll still hit bumps in the road. There’ll be days full of doubt. But you’ve learned to trust yourself, and trust the process a little more.
Living the year of “yes” is about so much more than the word itself. It’s about being present, being brave, and staying open to growth. It’s finding joy in the surprises, and shaping a life that feels genuine and true to you.
So often, we wait for the perfect moment to make a change. But here’s the truth: every single day is a brand new chance to say yes—to yourself, to the people around you, to life itself.
